root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `p` must remain live and caller-owned when `p2 == NULL` and `len > 0`; the OOM path must not release it through `mrb_free(mrb, p)`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `mrb_realloc()` cannot satisfy a nonzero resize request, it must raise NoMemoryError without freeing the existing buffer `p`, because callers such as `ary_expand_capa()` still retain that array heap pointer on the unwind path.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable branch frees `p` before raising, so later teardown sees the same array buffer as if it were still live. The fixed branch preserves `p` across the raise and leaves the teardown free as the first and only release.

nodes.description: During `mrb_close()` teardown, `obj_free()` reaches `mrb_free()` on the tracked array heap pointer, which is the AddressSanitizer-reported second free in the vulnerable run.

edges.relation: After `mrb_realloc()` handles the failed growth request for array buffer `p`, later GC teardown reaches the same pointer through `((struct RArray*)obj)->as.heap.ptr` and executes the array free in `obj_free()` on it.
